facilities.name: Vindskydd, Björnerödspiggen
facilities.description: Shelter, grill/fireplace, benches and viewpoint/viewing tower at Björnerödspiggen, Bohuslän's highest point. WST also lists the facility and says it was built in November 2024. WST coordinate [59.013411, 11.401792] is about 144 m from route, while OSM/Vindskyddskartan/Grillplatser coordinates are close to the line; Check final coordinate before runtime import. Water barrel/rainwater is mentioned by third-party sources but quality is unknown/not recommended; do not import as drinking water.
